title: 宇宙高歌東方紅 (The Universe Sings "The East Is Red")
notes: 1970 PRC documentary, Mandarin: Dongfanghong-1. The long window is the satellite's own 20.009 MHz transmission of 東方紅 played back on air, over the satellite turning and a telemetry trace; also the launch klaxon at Jiuquan, the launch itself, an optical tracking mount, a Yagi array and the control room, and the satellite on the bench. Re-cut 2026-09-25 from a clean, unmarked copy of the same transfer on YouTube (怀旧影像館, 960×720, frame-identical, so the windows are unchanged); the earlier Bilibili upload (BV1mRG1zxEVg, 记忆走廊, corner logo) is kept as the previous source.
